description: 洪水時の指定緊急避難場所一覧 [evacuation shelters and public facilities and flood] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 延岡市. 洪水時の指定緊急避難場所一覧です。. Coverage: 延岡市. The portal files it under the publisher 延岡市. Its tags are 台風, 指定緊急避難所, 施設, 水害, 洪水. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2023-04-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
